definitions.explanation: A place serving simple, affordable meals, often found in schools, offices, or as small eateries.
A room in a house or building used for eating meals.

examples.japanese: {学校|がっこう}の{食堂|しょくどう}で{昼|ひる}ごはんを{食|た}べます。
examples.english: I eat lunch at the school cafeteria.

examples.japanese: この{食堂|しょくどう}は{安|やす}くておいしいです。
examples.english: This eatery is cheap and delicious.

examples.japanese: {社員|しゃいん}{食堂|しょくどう}は12{時|じ}から{開|あ}きます。
{食堂|しょくどう}は{家族|かぞく}が{集|あつ}まる{大切|たいせつ}な{場所|ばしょ}です。
examples.english: The dining room is an important place where the family gathers.

examples.japanese: {大学|だいがく}の{食堂|しょくどう}は{学生|がくせい}でいつも{混|こ}んでいます。
examples.english: The university cafeteria is always crowded with students.

examples.japanese: {大衆|たいしゅう}{食堂|しょくどう}で{昼食|ちゅうしょく}を{食|た}べた。
examples.english: I ate lunch at a casual eatery.

examples.japanese: {食堂|しょくどう}のメニューは{日替|ひが}わりです。
{食堂|しょくどう}にテーブルを{置|お}いた。
examples.english: I put a table in the dining room.

examples.japanese: {食堂|しょくどう}で{朝食|ちょうしょく}を{取|と}ります。
examples.english: I have breakfast in the dining room.

examples.japanese: {食堂|しょくどう}の{照明|しょうめい}を{変|か}えた。
examples.english: I changed the dining room lighting.

notes: {食堂|しょくどう} can mean a cafeteria ({学生食堂|がくせいしょくどう} student cafeteria, {社員食堂|しゃいんしょくどう} company cafeteria) or a small, casual restaurant serving home-style food. {大衆食堂|たいしゅうしょくどう} are traditional working-class eateries. The word combines {食|しょく} (eat) and {堂|どう} (hall).
